items.prompt: At a trial Y-query midpoint, computed price is above the target. Which bisection action follows decreasing positive-cashflow price?

options.text: Lower the upper yield endpoint to the midpoint.
options.why: That moves toward still-higher prices, the wrong direction.

options.text: Stop because every positive price is acceptable.
options.why: The target price determines a specific yield within the bracket.

options.text: Raise the lower yield endpoint to the midpoint.
options.why: Increasing yield lowers the price, preserving P(lower)>=target>=P(upper).

options.text: Change the coupon rate to force agreement.
options.why: The contract solves yield for a fixed schedule, not a new bond.

items.explanation: Increasing yield lowers the price, preserving P(lower)>=target>=P(upper).
